result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **MailerLite**\. It offers the best balance of affordability, ease of use and useful marketing automation without being overly complicated.

However, the best choice depends on the type of business you run.

## My top 5 email marketing tools

**1\. MailerLite**

(Best overall)

- Easy to use, even for beginners.
- Beautiful email templates.
- Automated welcome emails and follow-ups.
- Landing pages and signup forms.
- Free plan available.

Website: [MailerLite](https://www.mailerlite.com/)

![Brevo vs Monday.com: Which Platform Is Best for CRM, Marketing, and Work Management in 2026?](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/X0xMoQclWGiDY2eR4uBCX4oJ5HTcGAK7hu9BellDrFKleCnsnvgdDMG9nupBWSJrtO9AIr_oIoUoNE7Jnkdr0l_sbK6OWfVoPNP5hOYyzanzV9yAIcF20yDn1mMM_81n35K4c6ftiknby2A04pBUThNzXDJL3HqIzMA6vOQhsHGtX6hu3G0FtOXDCQWLdMre?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Brevo**

(Best budget option)

- Email and SMS marketing.
- Built-in CRM.
- Free plan with 300 emails per day.
- Good for businesses with larger contact lists.

Website: [Brevo](https://www.brevo.com/)

---

![10 best logos using yellow & black | by Drahomír Posteby-Mach | Design + Sketch | Medium](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aggGMYuu2gcGAfWqecOIQQHQR8KEiBe-BwYHcRS_Mvvg027HTDscERLrafo-FPvXB4FxL-7jydk97BfNTqbqTBODNfsaWQScr41vv2DnURVhy-ljekJZkELqLRyjifahHkVU8zBArEaDvXXQ0VSTnqj1qGR3s9uyKpHzn2qswJxYawbs3toDg2X5t3B7-sq6?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Mailchimp**

- Very beginner-friendly.
- Lots of integrations.
- Good email templates and reporting.
- Can become expensive as your list grows.

Website: [Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com/)

---

![ActiveCampaign - Blue Ninja](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EouKh9P45dha8lf5y8rFcjosqmGPnqMhUC4vUxsIsmJOZKXfFv0WZ2M1Rt5aQTQVatptyFzb00u5rqUyyUt5nfAXNZcW3dYEUdrs0bSWR3k4b7jAtS4qbGi6ODF8iEsLzx8-yCF6Ei8Iq2gQO7peSlhUyHgt-4tOb8_yPRbh44WijrMMqO0EHfxwcZeCPQ-d?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. ActiveCampaign**

- Excellent marketing automation.
- Advanced customer segmentation.
- Automated sales journeys and follow-ups.
- Better for businesses ready to scale.

Website: [ActiveCampaign](https://www.activecampaign.com/)

---

![Klaviyo - Bigblue](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/fARepdqZf8WP2WNSrlxU-72h4Ox8v3onKnvM91J3W0JqFMUmEZa4auIA6yri8ok4VvcyZL571tAochy-8DRLNjAYaYm6iDCaSS9ts70lpNh38hiANMQTK_XQUatRAoaY4hT9sgPhrd_1_awBkIMg19_va0PpS3FT3DD3_oDsAVOdRqzbtojim6Y1HvpwPswe?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Klaviyo**

- Excellent for online shops.
- Automated abandoned-cart emails.
- Customer purchase behaviour tracking.
- Strong Shopify integration.

Website: [Klaviyo](https://www.klaviyo.com/)

| Klaviyo | Ecommerce | Best for online shops |
